review_locator: PMCID:PMC4445728, The Development and in vivo function of TH9 cells
primary_title: Itk is required for Th9 differentiation via TCR-mediated induction of IL-2 and IRF4; BCL6 Controls Th9 Cell Development by Repressing Il9 Transcription
decision_basis: The review-guided primary evidence shows IL-2 or constitutively active STAT5 rescues IL-9 expression in Th9-lineage cells, while IL-2 blockade/JAK3-STAT5 inhibition reduces STAT5 occupancy and Il9 promoter output.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-2-associated IL9 gene-expression bridge alongside the existing IL2 receptor-complex-to-STAT5 edge; preserve Th9 polarization, STAT5/BCL6 competition and cooperative-factor context, with no SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4445728, The Development and in vivo function of TH9 cells
primary_title: Itk is required for Th9 differentiation via TCR-mediated induction of IL-2 and IRF4
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows that IL-2 rescues IRF4 expression in Itk-deficient CD4+ T cells and that STAT5 binds the Irf4 promoter, supporting an IL-2-associated IRF4 gene output.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-2-associated IRF4 gene-expression bridge; preserve the Itk/TCR-to-IL-2 and STAT5-promoter-binding context and do not infer that IRF4 is a terminal TF node in this edge.
